title: Marketplace has one unified header with a featured area menu, friendly closable tips and sections that slide in beneath

source.ref: Daniel 2026-10-20, unified marketplace header and area tips

detail: The Marketplace route group layout mounts one header: title, a pinned feature menu (each area with a one-line purpose), and a closable tip for the active area (remembered per browser). Area bodies slide in beneath it and their own headings are h2.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const t=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/marketplace/area-nav.tsx','utf8');const l=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/(marketplace)/layout.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!t.includes('FqMarketHeader')||!t.includes('fqm-tip'))bad.push('no unified header with tips');if(!l.includes('MarketSlide'))bad.push('group layout does not slide content');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1037: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the unified header, tips or slide wrapper are missing.
